cause.meaning: Meta template-format rejection for a leading or trailing parameter.
cause.diagnosis: The v1 body ended with "{{2}}." — the final positional parameter was followed only by a full stop. Punctuation alone does not satisfy Meta's requirement that a body must not end with a parameter. The body did have static text before {{1}}, so the leading-parameter half of the rule was already satisfied; only the trailing half failed.
